description: Defines the in-memory high-level intermediate representation of shaders as a hierarchy of node classes, including various node types such as expressions, statements, and control flow constructs, used in shader compilation and parsing.

classes.name: TIntermNode
classes.description: Base class for all shader intermediate nodes, providing traversal and child management.

classes.name: TIntermTyped
classes.description: Intermediate class for nodes with a type, representing typed expressions or statements.

classes.name: TIntermLoop
classes.description: Represents loop constructs (for, while, do-while) in shader code.

classes.name: TIntermBranch
classes.description: Represents control flow statements like break, continue, return.

classes.name: TIntermSymbol
classes.description: Represents variable symbols in the shader code.

classes.name: TIntermExpression
classes.description: Represents typed expressions that are not just symbols.

classes.name: TIntermConstantUnion
classes.description: Represents constant values, possibly folded during compilation.

classes.name: TIntermOperator
classes.description: Base class for nodes that hold operators.

classes.name: TIntermSwizzle
classes.description: Represents vector swizzle operations.

classes.name: TIntermBinary
classes.description: Represents binary math operators.

classes.name: TIntermUnary
classes.description: Represents unary math operators.

classes.name: TIntermAggregate
classes.description: Represents nodes with an arbitrary number of children, such as function calls or blocks.

classes.name: TIntermBlock
classes.description: Represents a list of statements or a block of code.

classes.name: TIntermFunctionPrototype
classes.description: Represents function prototype declarations.

classes.name: TIntermFunctionDefinition
classes.description: Represents function definitions with prototype and body.

classes.name: TIntermDeclaration
classes.description: Represents variable or struct declarations.

classes.name: TIntermGlobalQualifierDeclaration
classes.description: Represents declarations for invariance or qualifiers.

classes.name: TIntermTernary
classes.description: Represents ternary conditional expressions.

classes.name: TIntermIfElse
classes.description: Represents if-else control flow.

classes.name: TIntermSwitch
classes.description: Represents switch statements.

classes.name: TIntermCase
classes.description: Represents case labels in switch statements.

classes.name: TIntermPreprocessorDirective
classes.description: Represents preprocessor directives like #define, #ifdef.
